Congress Demands Drought Aid for Maharashtra Farmers

The Congress party has demanded that the Maharashtra government declare a drought and provide ₹50,000 per hectare to affected farmers. This call comes as Maharashtra is facing a severe drought situation, with September emerging as particularly alarming for the state, which is among India's worst-hit.
